data.one_liner: A Dart wrapper for the Telegram Bot API to send and receive messages.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Bot class to interact with Telegram Bot API, handling updates, sending messages, and configuring allowed update types. Works on native, Flutter, and JavaScript platforms.
use_when: You need a quick way to integrate a Telegram bot into a Dart or Flutter app
You prefer a lightweight wrapper without heavy dependencies
avoid_when: You require advanced features like built‑in state management or code generation
You need a highly opinionated architecture for bot handling
strengths: Supports both functional and OOP usage styles
Works across multiple platforms (android, ios, web, desktop)
weaknesses: Limited to Telegram; no multi‑service support
Relies on manual error handling for network issues
No built‑in code generation or advanced abstractions

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: A generic HTTP client that can be used to call Telegram Bot API directly without an additional wrapper

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers more features like interceptors and advanced request handling for custom Telegram integrations
